body.statement: The algorithm \(\mathsf{Enum}(W)\) emits every member of \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{stab}}(W)\) exactly once. If \(c=|C|\) and \(e_C\) is the number of admissibility edges in block \(C\), its local screening time is \(\sum_C O((c^{1/2}e_C+cN_{\mathrm{adm}}(W_C))\operatorname{poly}(c,L))\), after which Cartesian-product output has \(O(q)\) delay per stable assignment. The claim is output-sensitive in the enumerated local matching fibers and does not assert polynomial delay in \(N_{\mathrm{stab}}(W)\) alone.
body.justification: The bound makes the positive algorithmic content exact without hiding rejected local matchings behind a polynomial-delay claim.
body.gap: Uno enumerates unfiltered perfect matchings, while prior local causal discovery does not integrate normalized Schur screening or SCC products.
body.consumer: The procedure is an exact fallback for stable matching frequencies when the largest feedback SCC is small.
